about: [O8] the physics layer, the falls (the bed, ?start=cast.falls): a man punched down in the open (he gets up out of how he lies), one shot against the facade, one in a doorway, one on a stoop's steps - each settles (asleep) within 4.5 s of the blow, no part under the walking surface by more than 3 cm, no point more than 4 cm into a wall or a post; the second round of the same (they stand again every nine seconds). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o8/falls.json

steps.label: the four falls of the first round lie still

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(G.castBed.rec.map((r) => ({ name: r.name, n: r.n, settled: r.settled, minY: +r.minY.toFixed(3), through: r.through, at: r.at })))

steps.label: round 1: settled within 4.5 s, nothing under the surface, nothing into a wall

steps.until: (() => { const S = G.castBed.stations.find((s) => s.name === 'knock'); return S && S.p && S.p.standing && S.t > 5.5 && S.t < 8.5; })()
steps.label: the man punched down gets up out of how he lies

steps.eval: JSON.stringify(G.castBed.rec.filter((r) => r.n === 2).map((r) => ({ name: r.name, settled: r.settled, minY: +r.minY.toFixed(3), through: r.through, at: r.at })))
